Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding intellectual diversity at institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to intellectual diversity; and adding a new sectionto chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Institutions of higher education shall promote intellectualdiversity on their campuses. (2) For the purposes of this section, "intellectual diversity"includes, but is not limited to, a learning environment that exposesstudents to a variety of political and ideological perspectives thatrelate to the subject matter being taught or issues being discussed. (3) Each institution of higher education shall take the followingsteps, at a minimum, to ensure that intellectual diversity is occurringon its campus: (a) Incorporate intellectual diversity into the institution'sstatements, grievance procedures, and activities on diversity; (b) Encourage a balanced approach to panels and speakers thatappear on campus; p. 1 SB 6893 (c) Establish campus policies that ensure speakers are notprevented from speaking due to hecklers or threats of violence; (d) Include intellectual diversity in the institution's guidelineson teaching and program development; and (e) Develop a procedure in which a student may present his or herobjection to a classroom assignment due to its opposition with thestudent's conscience. (4) The higher education coordinating board shall require eachinstitution of higher education to report to the legislature on thesteps the institution is taking to promote intellectual diversity oncampus. The report shall be submitted to the legislature no later thanDecember 1, 2008.
